verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software product, so API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this kind of offering. The evidence shows no API of any kind: llms.txt and every OpenAPI probe path return 404. The few web resources (an online investor-readiness tool and a UPC decision tracker site) are marketing aids, not a software product with an interface to mirror.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
